newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Death-cheating Brazilian turns up at own funeral.
newsitem.headline: Death-cheating Brazilian turns up at own funeral.

text.p: A Brazilian handyman who has cheated death twice in the past returned home this week to find he had missed his own funeral by two hours.
Lourival Souza de Santos, 33, who has previously survived a smashed skull and multiple bullet wounds, was declared dead on Tuesday.
A police spokesman in the Itapua suburb of the northeastern city of Salvador said Santos' brother mistakenly identified him as a murder victim, whose face had been mutilated by gunshots.

"The irony is that Lourival has survived a crushed skull in a fight and eight bullet wounds from a murder attempt," he told Reuters by telephone. "It's only when nothing at all had happened to him that he was finally declared dead."
"It's like I have three lives, at least," Santos told national Globo television.
News agency Agencia Estado quoted Santos' mother as saying she thought the corpse the family buried on Tuesday was "slightly large."
